title: IELTS Academic Writing Task 1: Process Diagram – Resource Allocation and Stage Checks
prompt: The diagram below shows the process by which a community library allocates its annual resource budget and conducts stage checks before opening a new reading room. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.
instructions: 本题为模拟练习，所有场景与数据均为虚构，并非官方雅思试卷。请先花约5分钟分析流程图：注意流程的起点与终点、各阶段的主要任务、检查点的位置以及资源（预算、人力、时间）如何在阶段间分配。写作时，用一段概述（overview）点出流程的主要特征与关键对比，再分2–3段描述各阶段的具体步骤与检查机制。不要加入个人观点或解释原因。确保字数不少于150词。

figure.title: Community Library Resource Allocation and Stage-Check Process for a New Reading Room
steps: Step 1: Annual budget request submitted by the library management team
Step 2: Resource allocation committee reviews the request and assigns a provisional budget
Step 3: Stage check 1 – committee verifies that the provisional budget covers core resources (books, shelving, lighting)
Step 4: Procurement team purchases and installs core resources
Step 5: Stage check 2 – committee inspects installed resources and confirms they meet safety and accessibility standards
Step 6: Staff training and volunteer recruitment conducted for the new reading room
Step 7: Stage check 3 – committee assesses staffing readiness and approves the opening date
Step 8: Reading room opens to the public and initial usage is monitored for three months
Step 9: Final review meeting held to compare actual resource use with the provisional budget and record lessons learned
